$comment: Motion C v1. A declared AI initiative establishes a reason to INVESTIGATE, never product fit. Platform, workload and accelerator context are required and are not claimed from the initiative alone — no predicate records GPU estate, so it stays required context until one does.
name: RHAI + NVIDIA AI Growth
objective: Qualify and advance a joint AI-platform opportunity where the account has declared an AI initiative.

motion_v1.objective: Qualify and advance a joint AI-platform opportunity where the account has declared an AI initiative.

requires.because: the account has declared an initiative that names AI workloads
platform or accelerator context is established, so a joint solution hypothesis has something to rest on

requiresContext: AI workload and use-case class — training, fine-tuning or inference is unrecorded.
Compute and GPU estate — no predicate records accelerator infrastructure.
Platform and runtime context for where the workload would run.
Accelerator vendor relationship — `partner_relationship_exists` holds no observations.
motion_v1.goalTemplate: Qualify and advance a joint AI-platform opportunity at {{company}}.
motion_v1.campaignGuidance: Open on the initiative the account has already declared. Do not assert a platform, accelerator or workload the evidence has not established — the first conversation exists to find those out.
measurementAssociations: An opportunity opened on this account in the AI platform category after application — association only.
Evidence added recording accelerator estate or workload class, which would close the largest gaps.

personas.primary: VP Data / Head of AI Platform

cta.offer: Workload readiness review for the declared initiative
cta.fallback: Reference architecture for the stated workload class

seller_cadence.action: Validate the AI workload and use case, the platform context and the accelerator estate
Determine the RHAI and NVIDIA solution hypothesis and the gaps it depends on
Align partner and vendor technical and sales resources on the next customer action
